description: RLCDAlignBench: 44 alignment-failure detection benchmarks and code for 'Just Ask Jev' (RLCD zero-shot detector of AI alignment failures)
summary: The probability-readout finding is the one I'd actually build on: treating a single calibrated call as soft probabilities rather than an argmax gets 0.886 median AUROC zero-shot across 44 benchmarks and five 2B–7B models, which is the small, local, composable trust signal I want sitting between my PenguPool agent sessions and whatever they execute. I also like the negative result — question phrasing barely matters and context only helps when it leaks the label — because it's the kind of sobering evidence I want before wiring a detector into a pipeline instead of another "just prompt it harder" story.
